title: ArchFlow Document Artifact v1
$comment: The normative structural authority for a projected agent document. D3 — `document_path` is the TASK-relative frame and `projection_target` is the REPOSITORY frame; the two $defs are the same underlying claim validator, so the frame is named at the reference site and is not runtime-checkable. D19 — `step` is required here as well as in the type alias and the Zod mirror; the fingerprint correlation keys on (phase_instance, step).

path_class.$comment: A const, not the 17-member path class vocabulary.

byte_count.$comment: D8 declares no own minimum: a zero-byte document is legal, so `safeInteger` is the right $ref.

declared_inputs.$comment: SET — sorted by `input_id`, duplicates rejected. The keyword and the Zod mirror both call `isSortedUniqueBy` with `tupleKey("input_id")`, so the two authorities are one predicate.

snapshot_digest.$comment: Domain-separated canonical declared-output snapshot; never the retained result address.

editorial_predecessor.$comment: Optional editorial-revision link: the predecessor produce artifact digest, its input fingerprint, and the retained result digest of the authorizing accepted-editorial triage. Record-time semantics are enforced by the state handler, not here.
